一级方程式在墨西哥城的周六比赛中，查尔斯·勒克莱尔以在赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道周五两场练习赛中排名第一的速度领跑
勒克莱尔在FP2中领先兰多·诺里斯0.103秒，乔治·罗素以0.003秒的差距排在第三。车手积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利排在第四，领先马克斯·维斯塔潘，三支车队在排位赛中竞争激烈。
法拉利的周五并不完全顺利，因为刘易斯·汉密尔顿在FP2练习中失去了动力，中途停车。
安东内利仍然处于赢得他第一个一级方程式世界锦标赛的边缘，但周六的排位赛将决定他是否能在周日开始完成这项工作。

detailEn: F1 Mexico GP: Saturday schedule, weather forecast and how to watch
What time Free Practice 3 and qualifying start at the 2026 Formula 1 Mexico Grand Prix, plus the full Mexico City schedule, weather forecast and how to watch live
Formula 1 heads into Saturday in Mexico City with Charles Leclerc setting the pace after topping both Friday practice sessions at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez.

Leclerc led FP2 by 0.103s over Lando Norris, with George Russell just 0.003s further back in third. Championship leader Kimi Antonelli was fourth ahead of Max Verstappen, leaving three teams closely matched heading into qualifying.
Ferrari’s Friday was not entirely clean, however, as Lewis Hamilton lost power and stopped midway through FP2.
Antonelli remains on the verge of securing his first Formula 1 world championship, but Saturday’s qualifying session will determine whether he starts Sunday in a position to finish the job.
Here is everything you need to know ahead of Saturday’s running at the F1 Mexico GP.
How can I watch the F1 Mexico GP?

How you can watch Formula 1 depends on where you are. For viewers in the United Kingdom, Sky Sports continues as the championship’s exclusive broadcaster, showing every session live throughout the 2026 season. F1 coverage can also be streamed via Sky Go or NOW, with highlights available free-to-air on Channel 4.

In the United States, Apple TV is the primary broadcast partner for the 2026 season, with all sessions available on the platform following a multi-year deal. F1 TV remains the series’ global subscription streaming service.
Motorsport.com will provide live coverage and updates throughout the Mexico GP weekend.

The weather report is quite straightforward, until qualifying. Saturday should begin sunny and dry in Mexico City, with temperatures around 24-26C for FP3.
Conditions could become less settled for qualifying, with temperatures rising to 26-27C and a brief shower possible, although significant rain is not expected.
Sunday is currently forecast to be sunny and dry for the Mexico Grand Prix.

The Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez sits more than 2,200 metres above sea level, where the thinner air creates unusual demands on cooling, aerodynamics and power units despite the circuit’s relatively conventional layout. Its long main straight and stadium section are among its defining features.

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen sends blunt warning to Liam Lawson after Mexican GP FP2 clash
items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen criticised Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson after the two made contact during flying laps in second practice for the Mexican Grand Prix, saying it was "not very smart behaviour" from a driver fighting for his seat.
detailZh: 墨西哥大奖赛第二节练习赛发生冲突后，马克斯·维斯塔潘向利亚姆·劳森发出直言警告
墨西哥大奖赛练习赛中发生碰撞后，马克斯·维斯塔潘批评了利亚姆·劳森“不太聪明的行为”
致红牛车迷。关注红牛车队，获取来自米尔顿凯恩斯的F1新闻、车手动态、技术洞察与赛事分析。
四届一级方程式世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘在墨西哥大奖赛第二节练习赛中与小红牛车手利亚姆·劳森发生碰撞后对其提出批评，警告称对于一名正在为席位而战的车手来说，这是“不太聪明的行为”。
在周五于罗德里格斯兄弟赛道进行的第二节自由练习中，红牛车队车手与劳森都在进行飞驰圈时发生了接触。
当天空体育F1询问这是否只是一次不幸的事件时，维斯塔潘明确表达了自己的看法。
“嗯，我不认为这能叫不幸。也许他当时想做的举动不太明智，”这位荷兰车手解释道。“我的意思是，归根结底这不会改变我的周末，但如果我是他，我会表现得稍微聪明一点。而且，当你在为自己的席位而战时，这种行为可不太明智。”
劳森与红牛姊妹车队签订的合同将于2026年底到期。
维斯塔潘在第二节练习赛结束后接受 Motorsport.com 及其他媒体采访时，对这起事件做了更详细的描述。
他说：“我当时正在做一个快速的出场圈，因为我遇到了一些小问题。所以我推进得比较猛。他开得非常慢。于是我想，好吧，那就冲一把。但他一看到我过来，也开始加速了。”
“我不知道他脑子里在想什么，然后就发生了那样的事，想把我挤出赛道。对我来说，以他的位置来跟我挑事，这种行为实在不太明智。”
劳森因在第二节练习赛中驾驶行为异常而被传唤至赛会干事，但截至发稿时，赛会干事尚未公布任何决定。
这位新西兰车手目前以77分在车手积分榜上排名第九，而他的小红牛新秀队友阿尔维德·林德布拉德以38分排名第11。维斯塔潘以236分排名第四。
detailEn: Max Verstappen sends blunt warning to Liam Lawson after Mexican GP FP2 clash
Max Verstappen has criticised Liam Lawson's "not very smart behaviour" following their collision during Mexican GP practice
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has criticised Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson after the pair came together in second practice for the Mexican Grand Prix, warning that it was "not very smart behaviour" from a driver fighting for his seat.
The Red Bull driver and Lawson were both on flying laps when they made contact during Friday's FP2 session at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez.
Asked by Sky Sports F1 whether it was simply an unlucky incident, Verstappen made his feelings clear.

"Well, I don't think it's called unlucky. Maybe not very smart behaviour, what he was trying to do there," the Dutchman explained. "I mean, at the end of the day it's not going to change my weekend, but if I were him I would act a little bit smarter. Also, when you're fighting for your seat, it's not very smart behaviour."
Lawson's contract with the Red Bull sister team expires at the end of 2026.
Verstappen went into more detail about the incident while speaking to Motorsport.com and other media after the second practice session.

"I was on a fast out-lap because I had some little issues," he said. "So I was pushing on quite a bit. He was driving really slow. So I was like, all right, let's go for it. But as soon as he saw me arrive, he started to speed up as well.
"I don't know what was going through his head and that happened, trying to just run me off the track. For me, it's just not very smart behaviour when you're in his position to pick a fight with me."
Lawson has been summoned to the stewards for driving erratically during FP2, but no decision from the stewards has been released at the time of writing.
The New Zealander currently sits ninth in the drivers' standings with 77 points, while his Racing Bulls rookie team-mate Arvid Lindblad is 11th with 38 points. Verstappen is fourth with 236 points.

items.summaryEn: Max Verstappen and Liam Lawson collided wheel to wheel through the stadium sector in second practice for the Mexico Grand Prix, sending debris onto the track and causing a brief red flag. Verstappen criticised Lawson afterwards, saying the move was not "very smart" given the New Zealander is fighting for his Formula 1 future.
detailZh: 维斯塔潘批评劳森在墨西哥大奖赛二练中的碰撞
两车在体育场路段轮对轮相撞，各自车上的碎片飞出
墨西哥大奖赛第二节练习中，马克斯·维斯塔潘与利亚姆·劳森发生碰撞后，维斯塔潘批评了劳森，称考虑到这位新西兰车手正为自己的F1未来而战，这次碰撞“不太聪明”。
二练开始约15分钟后，红牛和小红牛的车手在体育场路段轮对轮相撞，导致两人碰撞，碎片散落赛道，引发短暂红旗。
维斯塔潘先是在12号弯切入内线，随后劳森在下一个弯尝试了类似的超车动作，导致这位四届世界冠军冲出赛道。
因此，当天空体育询问该事件是否“不走运”时，维斯塔潘回答道：“嗯，我不认为这能叫不走运。也许他在那里试图做的事情不太明智。”
“归根结底，这不会改变我的比赛周末，但如果我是他，我会表现得稍微聪明一点。而且当你在为自己的席位而战时，这种行为可不太聪明。”
维斯塔潘随后经历了一场艰难的比赛，由于碰撞造成损伤，他最终仅列第五，落后最快圈速创造者夏尔·勒克莱尔0.311秒。
红牛车队负责人洛朗·梅基斯对德国天空体育表示：“马克斯的那节练习显然受到了一些干扰，因为他和利亚姆发生了接触。”
“所以赛车那里有相当程度的损伤，这有点可惜，因为显然我们只能带着那样的车况继续跑。”
“但话说回来，马克斯也在逐步提升。整体情况还有些模糊，但毫无疑问今晚我们有一些工作要做，好把他们调到一个更好的窗口里。”
至于劳森，他最终排在第九，落后勒克莱尔0.628秒；这位新西兰车手在2026赛季表现令人印象深刻，目前以77分有望创下职业生涯最佳的年度第九名。
但他在2027赛季发车阵容中的位置仍未确定，因为他效力于红牛的姊妹车队，而这支车队通常只是奥地利品牌旗下最优秀年轻车手的临时落脚点。
然而这已经是劳森第二个完整赛季，在2025年红牛经历了一段令人失望的时期后，他回归的可能性不大，因此他在该组织内部的未来存在疑问。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，利亚姆·劳森，红牛车队
这尤其是因为F2冠军争夺者尼古拉·措洛夫——红牛的下一位天才车手，而他的队友是新秀阿维德·林德布拉德，后者表现稳健，已获得38分。
梅基斯补充谈到这起事件：“他们中没有人在跑快圈。所以我只能说，这看起来非常、非常没有必要。”
“这类事情时有发生，本不该发生，但它确实发生了。在那之后唯一让我在意的是赛车受损了。这就是我们面临的问题，但我们明天会把它处理好。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen slams Liam Lawson for FP2 clash at F1 Mexico GP
Both drivers went wheel to wheel through the stadium sector, causing debris to fly off each car

Max Verstappen has criticised Liam Lawson following their clash in second practice for the Mexico Grand Prix, claiming it wasn’t “very smart” given the New Zealander is fighting for his Formula 1 future.
The Red Bull and Racing Bulls drivers went wheel to wheel through the stadium sector after 15 minutes, causing both to collide and cause a brief red flag with debris on the circuit.
Verstappen first went down the inside of Turn 12 before Lawson attempted a similar move for the following corner, which caused the four-time world champion to go off.
So when asked by Sky Sports if the incident was “unlucky”, Verstappen replied: “Well I don't think it's called unlucky. Maybe not very smart behaviour, what he was trying to do there.
“At the end of the day it's not going to change my weekend but if I would be him, I would act a little bit smarter. Also when you're fighting for your seat it's not very smart behaviour.”
Verstappen subsequently endured a tough session by finishing down in fifth, 0.311s off pacesetter Charles Leclerc, having suffered damage from the collision.
Red Bull boss Laurent Mekies told Sky Sports Germany: “Max had a bit of a disturbed session obviously with the contact with Liam.
“So quite a bit of car damage there, so it's a bit of a shame because obviously we had to carry on like that with the car.
“But again, Max as well is building up. The picture is a bit blurred, but no doubt we'll have a bit of work to do tonight to put them in a better window.”
For Lawson, he finished ninth, 0.628s behind Leclerc, amid an impressive 2026 campaign for the Kiwi who is on course for a career best ninth in the standings with 77 points.
But his spot on the 2027 grid is still undecided considering he is at Red Bull’s sister team, which is usually only a temporary home for the Austrian’s marques best youngsters.
Yet this is now Lawson’s second, full season and after a disappointing time at Red Bull in 2025, a return is unlikely so there are questions surrounding his future within the organisation.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, Liam Lawson, Red Bull Racing
That is particularly because of F2 title contender Nikola Tsolov, Red Bull’s next prodigy, whereas his team-mate is rookie Arvid Lindblad who has performed solidly with 38 points.
Mekies added on the incident: “None of them is in a fast lap. So all I can say is that it looks very, very unnecessary.
“These things happen, it should not happen, but it happens. The only thing that interests me after that is that the car is damaged. That's the issue we have, but we'll get it right tomorrow.”

detailZh: 奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂：麦凯轮在墨西哥高原的处理“比我预期的要好”
麦凯轮车手认为在FP2中软胎圈速混乱的情况下，他还有更多的进步空间
对于麦凯轮的粉丝来说，来自沃金的木瓜新闻，最新消息包括车手、赛车、团队策略以及每个周末的赛事
麦凯轮车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在墨西哥城的赛道FP2练习中带着乐观离开，他确认他的赛车在高海拔地区的表现比他预期的要好。尽管这位车手在排位赛中有一个‘相当混乱’的模拟圈速。
Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez赛道海拔超过2200米。稀薄的空气使得车队在比赛中几乎无法产生足够的下压力和冷却效果，这使得它成为日历中最具挑战性的周末之一。
FP2练习赛后，皮亚斯特里表示，实际情况并没有他想象中那么困难。
“当然很困难，但我觉得并没有比我预期的更糟，或者可能比我预期的还要好一点。所以，一切感觉都还不错。老实说，我觉得我们似乎相对有竞争力。”
澳大利亚人承认他的软胎圈速没有达到预期，但他相信这个木瓜色的车队的基本速度很强。
“我的FP2软胎圈速相当混乱，但我觉得整体节奏似乎还不错。所以法拉利看起来非常强大，我想在这种赛道上你可能会期待这样的表现，但我认为我们今天过得相当不错。”
皮亚斯蒂表示，纠正他的错误应该能让他排名更高，但他警告击败法拉利将会很困难。
“有几处很大的失误，所以我乐观地认为，如果我能整理好这些失误，我的排名也会更靠前，这种感觉很好。所以我认为明天要尝试击败法拉利将会非常困难，看起来就是这样。整个赛场上竞争非常激烈，所以你必须保持最佳状态。”
当被问及他是如何适应这些条件的驾驶时，皮亚斯蒂表示，根据今年的规定，低抓地力并不是什么新鲜事。
“这很艰难。抓地力极低。坦白说，今年车型的状况在大多数地方都类似，所以这里并没有那么戏剧化。但始终是一个挑战，不仅是对车辆的平衡性，今年在冷却发动机方面也非常困难。”
梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔周四表示，法拉利的较小涡轮可能会在高原上给它带来“相当大的优势”，因为2026年的规则取消了之前有助于消除涡轮迟滞的MGU-H。
但皮亚斯蒂里不同意涡轮将是决定性因素，补充说法拉利在直线上的速度并不特别快。
““他们今天看起来非常快。我认为涡轮的影响不会像我们想象的那么大。如果有什么的话，他们在直道上看起来有点慢，所以我们明天再看看。在某种情况下，它肯定会帮助他们，但我认为在正常条件下，它的影响并没有我们最初想象的那么大。”"
detailEn: Oscar Piastri: McLaren handled Mexico altitude “better than I was expecting”
The McLaren driver believes he has more to come after a “messy” soft-tyre lap in FP2
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.

McLaren driver Oscar Piastri walks away from FP2 in Mexico City's circuit with optimism as he confirms his car coped better with the high altitude than he expected it to. This comes despite the driver having a "pretty messy" qualifying simulation.

The Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez circuit sits more than 2,200 metres above sea level. The thin air leaves teams running with very little downforce and poor cooling, making it one of the most challenging weekends of the calendar.
Speaking after FP2, Piastri said the conditions had not been as tricky as he had feared.

“It was difficult for sure, but I don’t think necessarily worse than what I was expecting, or if anything it was probably a little bit better than I was expecting. So yeah, everything felt OK. I think we seemed to be relatively competitive, to be honest.”
The Australian admitted his soft-tyre lap failed to come together, but believed the papaya-coloured team's underlying pace is strong.

“My soft lap in FP2 was pretty messy, but I felt like the kind of overall pace seems to be there. So Ferrari looked very strong, which I guess you would kind of expect on a track like this, but I think we had a pretty good day.”
Piastri said that cleaning up his mistakes should put him much higher up the order, but warned that beating Ferrari would be difficult.

“There was a couple of very big mistakes, so I’m optimistic that if I can tidy those up, I’ll be a lot further up as well, which is a nice feeling to have. So I think to try and beat Ferrari tomorrow is going to be very tough, as it looks like. And it’s very tight, I would say, through the whole field, so you’re going to have to be on top of the game.”
Asked how he had adapted his driving to the conditions, Piastri said the low grip was nothing new under this year’s regulations.

“It’s tough. It’s just incredibly low grip. I think with this year’s cars, honestly, it’s a similar story in most places, so it doesn’t feel that dramatic here. But it’s always a challenge, not just for the car in terms of balance, but cooling the engines this year, it’s always very tough.”

Mercedes driver George Russell suggested on Thursday that Ferrari’s smaller turbo could give it “quite an advantage” at altitude, with the 2026 rules having dropped the MGU-H that previously helped to eliminate turbo lag.
But Piastri doesn't agree that the turbo will be the deciding factor, adding that Ferrari didn't look especially fast in a straight line.

“They looked very quick today. I don’t think the turbo is going to make as much of a difference as we thought. They, if anything, looked a bit slow on the straights, so let’s wait and see tomorrow. Definitely in some circumstances it will help them, but I think in normal conditions it’s not as big of a factor as we first thought.”

items.originalTitle: Colton Herta's F1 superlicence confusion explained: why he's still one point short
detailZh: 科尔顿·赫塔的F1超级执照困惑解析：为何还差一分
赫塔的超级执照情况在F1赛场上引起了巨大困惑。它与2025年印地赛车赛季有关；根据国际汽联，美国车手赫塔目前有39分——还不够申请超级执照。
赫塔在墨西哥大奖赛的首场自由练习赛中完成了超过100公里，看似已有40个超级执照积分，足以获得进入F1所需的执照。
然而，根据国际汽联，赫塔目前还差一分。
关于IndyCar 2025赛季的困惑
首先，回到基础。从其他锦标赛积累所需的40分有两种方式。FIA可以查看之前三年积累的所有积分，或者考虑之前两年加上当前赛季获得的积分。
“车手必须积累至少40分。FIA将考虑以下任一选项中积累的积分数量：(i)申请日期前一年的三年日历期间，或(ii)申请日期前一年的两年日历期间，加上申请日历年度积累的积分，取两者中较高者”，FIA的国际体育法典规定。
在赫塔的情况下，似乎选择的是前者：之前的三年加上他在当前赛季完成的F1练习赛，因为这些与特定年份无关。这位美国人从IndyCar带来了35分——关于这一点稍后还会提到——并通过他在F1自由练习赛中的表现获得了另外四分。
在墨西哥维修区，关于那些特别IndyCar积分的问题引起了相当大的混乱，关于总积分应该是35分还是36分。其中一些积分可以追溯到2023年IndyCar赛季；30分来自2024赛季，当时他获得了第二名；剩余的混乱与2025年的情况有关。
例如，在赫塔的维基百科页面上查找2025年IndyCar赛季的结果，人们会看到他被列为第七名，这仅值四个超级驾照积分。赫塔在那个赛季的积分与Felix Rosenqvist持平。
最初——当FIA在7月进行调查时——赫塔在IndyCar排名中位列第六，这将为他赢得六个积分。有了这六个积分，他现在将达到41分，轻松超过所需的40分——这也是维修区在第一次练习赛后的普遍看法。
然而，这被证明是错误的。FIA随后告知Motorsport.com，经过进一步调查，赫塔在2025年IndyCar赛季中被最终归类为第七名，这意味着目前他只有39分，还没有资格获得超级驾照。
这意味着赫塔需要再进行一次F1练习赛才能满足要求，凯迪拉克可以使用即将到来的圣保罗大奖赛或下一场在美国拉斯维加斯的F1周末。凯迪拉克已经表示，它打算给其弟子更多的自由练习机会，这意味着无论如何他都将满足超级执照的要求，但根据国际汽联的说法，他尚未在墨西哥做到这一点。
超级执照的有效期是多久，这对凯迪拉克意味着什么？
同样有趣的问题是，一旦FIA正式申请和颁发赫塔的超级执照，它的有效期将有多长。
严格来说，超级执照只有效期为一年，这可能会让人认为赫塔的潜在F1机会现在是或永远不是，并且必须在2027年发生。这与2024年印第安纳波利斯赛车赛季的30个超级执照积分有关，这些积分可能在2027年后失效。
然而，当Motorsport.com将这个问题提交给国际汽联（FIA）时，现实证明情况比这要复杂得多——而且对赫塔（Herta）来说要更有利。是的，超级驾照本身只有效期为一年，但申请它也提供了一个三年的安全网。
这个安全网与《国际体育法典》第13.1.5 b条相关，该条款规定，以下条件也足以获得另一张超级驾照：
“车手还必须满足以下至少一项要求：
“b) 获得超级驾照（不包括仅限自由练习的超级驾照），并且在申请之前，在前三年内至少完成过一次FIA一级方程式世界锦标赛比赛中的自由练习赛，累计至少100公里。”
具体来说，这意味着一旦一名车手获得了超级驾照，并且该驾照在一年后到期，他们就会成为'前驾照持有者'的类别。
这些'前驾照持有者'可以在完成至少100公里的一场F1自由练习赛的前提下，无需再次满足40分的要求，申请另一张超级驾照。
这意味着，在申请了赫塔的超级驾照后，凯迪拉克将有一个三年的窗口期，在这期间，如果美国车队打算这么做，他们可以给赫塔一个F1的机会。如果这个机会在2027年没有立即到来，赫塔的30个IndyCar积分确实会在未来失效，但他可以在接下来的几年里通过只需一场自由练习赛就能重新获得超级驾照——而不必再次担心40分的要求。
正式来说，凯迪拉克仍然需要确认2027年的车手阵容。在墨西哥的家乡赛事之前，塞戈维亚·佩雷斯（Sergio Pérez）的合同被重新谈判并延长至至少2029年，但在奥斯汀，马辛·布德科夫斯基（Marcin Budkowski）拒绝回答F1主持人提出的一个非常简单的问题，用'是'来回答。
车队负责人被问及两位车手是否有延长至本赛季之后的合同，但布德科夫斯基通过表示FIA新闻发布会不是讨论这个问题的场合来回避了这个问题。
因此，他为2027赛季之前可能的车手变动留下了可能的空间。当被问及时，瓦尔特里·博塔斯告诉Motorsport.com，他还没有担心可能失去他的F1赛车座位的担忧。
detailEn: Colton Herta's F1 superlicence confusion explained: why he's still one point short

Herta's superlicence situation has caused enormous confusion in the F1 paddock. It is linked to the 2025 IndyCar season; according to the FIA, the American currently has 39 points – not enough to apply for a superlicence yet

After completing more than 100 kilometres during the first free practice session at the Mexico Grand Prix, Colton Herta appeared to have 40 superlicence points to his name, which would be enough to qualify for the document required to secure a Formula 1 seat.
The reality, however, has proved far more complicated than that. According to the FIA, Herta is currently still one point short.
Confusion surrounding IndyCar’s 2025 season

First, back to basics. There are two ways to accumulate the required 40 points from other championships. The FIA can either look at all the points accumulated over the previous three calendar years or consider all the points earned over the previous two years plus the current season.

“The driver must have accumulated at least 40 points. The FIA will consider the number of points accumulated in either (i) the three-calendar year period immediately preceding the year of the date of the application, or (ii) the two-calendar year period immediately preceding the year of the date of the application in addition to points accumulated in the calendar year of the application, whichever is higher”, the FIA's International Sporting Code states.

In Herta's case, it appears to be the former option: the previous three years plus the F1 practice sessions he has completed during the current season, as those are not tied to a specific year. The American has brought 35 points with him from IndyCar – more on that later – and earned another four through his F1 free practice appearances.

There has been considerable confusion in the Mexico paddock over those IndyCar points in particular, and whether the total should be 35 or 36. One of those points dates back to the 2023 IndyCar season; 30 come from the 2024 season, when he finished runner-up; the remaining confusion relates to 2025.

Anyone looking up the results of the 2025 IndyCar season online, for example on Herta's Wikipedia page, will see him listed in seventh place, which would be worth just four superlicence points. Herta finished that season level on points with Felix Rosenqvist.

Initially – when the FIA conducted its investigation in July – Herta was listed sixth in the IndyCar standings, which would earn him six points. With those six points, he would now have reached 41 points, comfortably exceeding the required 40 – which was also the widespread belief in the paddock immediately after the first practice session.

However, that proved incorrect. The FIA subsequently informed Motorsport.com that, following further investigation, Herta has definitively been classified seventh in the 2025 IndyCar season, meaning that, as things stand, he has only 39 points and does not yet qualify for a superlicence.

This means Herta needs one more F1 practice session to meet the requirements, for which Cadillac could use the upcoming Sao Paulo Grand Prix or the next F1 weekend on American soil in Las Vegas. Cadillac has already expressed its intention to give its protege more free practice outings, meaning he will meet the superlicence requirements in any case, but, according to the FIA, he has not yet done so in Mexico.
How long is the superlicence valid, and what does this mean for Cadillac?
An equally interesting question is exactly how long Herta's superlicence will remain valid once it can officially be applied for and issued by the FIA.

Strictly speaking, a superlicence is only valid for one year, which might suggest that it is now or never for Herta's potential F1 opportunity, and that it has to happen in 2027. This is linked to the 30 superlicence points from the 2024 IndyCar season, which might expire after 2027.

However, when Motorsport.com put the matter to the FIA, the reality proved somewhat more complex than that as well – and somewhat more favourable for Herta. Yes, the superlicence itself is only valid for one year, but applying for it also provides a three-year safety net.
This safety net is linked to Article 13.1.5 b of the International Sporting Code, which states that the following is also sufficient to obtain another superlicence:
“The driver must also satisfy at least one of the following requirements:

“b) Have been granted a Super Licence (excluding Free Practice Only Super Licence) and, prior to application, have previously completed at least 100 km during a free practice session of an FIA Formula One World Championship competition, in any of the previous 3 years.”
In concrete terms, this means that once a driver has obtained a superlicence and it expires after a year, they fall into the category of 'previous licence holders'.

Those 'previous licence holders' can apply for another superlicence without having to meet the 40-point requirement again, provided they have completed at least 100 kilometres during an F1 free practice session.

This effectively means that, after applying for Herta's superlicence, Cadillac will have a three-year window in which to give him an F1 opportunity, if that is what the American team intends to do. If that opportunity does not come immediately in 2027, Herta's 30 IndyCar points will indeed expire in the future, but he can regain the superlicence in the following years with just one free practice session – without having to worry about the 40 points again.

Formally, Cadillac still has to confirm its driver line-up for 2027. Sergio Pérez's contract was renegotiated and extended until at least 2029 ahead of his home race in Mexico, but in Austin, Marcin Budkowski refused to answer a very simple question from the F1 presenter with a 'yes'.

The team principal was asked whether both drivers had contracts extending beyond the current season, but Budkowski avoided the question by saying that the FIA press conference was not the place to discuss it.

He thereby left the door open for a possible driver change ahead of the 2027 F1 season. Valtteri Bottas subsequently told Motorsport.com, when asked, that he was not yet concerned about potentially losing his F1 seat.

查尔斯·勒克莱尔为法拉利在周五的两次练习赛中排名第一；刘易斯·汉密尔顿在练习赛中遭遇技术故障；马克斯·维斯塔潘与利亚姆·劳森发生碰撞；在天空体育F1上观看墨西哥城大奖赛的所有练习赛，周六晚上9点进行排位赛，周日晚上8点进行正赛。
墨西哥城大奖赛周五练习赛亮点
勒克莱尔在墨西哥城大奖赛周五练习赛中完成双冠，但法拉利的强势表现因汉密尔顿遭遇技术问题而受到影响。
勒克莱尔以1:17.827秒的成绩完成比赛，领先于麦克拉伦的兰多·诺里斯和梅赛德斯的乔治·拉塞尔超过十分之一，这对英国车手是早些时候因让出位置给新晋车手而缺席了开幕式十名车手之一。
基米·安东内利，他只需要在周日的比赛中获得第九名，就能成为有史以来最年轻的一级方程式世界冠军，他在队友拉塞尔之下，排在第四位。

汉密尔顿在练习赛进行到中途时本有望成为最快，但在他的冲刺圈最后一段出现了似乎是由引擎问题引起的故障。
法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿在墨西哥城大奖赛FP2练习赛中抱怨动力问题后退赛。
他完成了这一圈，但随后被工程师迅速告知在赛道上停车，这提前结束了他的练习赛，使他无法获得竞争对手通过他们的比赛模拟所收集到的宝贵信息。
马克斯·维斯塔潘，另一位缺席了第一次练习的车手，以三十分之一秒的差距排在第五位，他的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排在后面。
小红牛的利亚姆·劳森和红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘在墨西哥城大奖赛的第二次练习中发生接触。
维斯塔潘在练习的早期阶段与他的前队友利亚姆·劳森发生了一场奇怪的碰撞，当时这位四次世界冠军试图超越小红牛的车手。
劳森进行了防守并保持了赛道位置，但战斗在接下来的几个弯道后继续，直到两人发生接触，导致赛道上留下碎片，因此抛出了红旗以便清理。
这对搭档不仅需要向他们的车队解释，这两个车队都属于红牛家族，还需要向 的中文翻译为裁判解释，因为他们被要求在练习结束后见到他们。

detailEn: Mexico City GP: Charles Leclerc completes Friday practice double as Ferrari team-mate Lewis Hamilton suffers technical failure

Charles Leclerc tops both Friday practice sessions for Ferrari; Lewis Hamilton suffers technical failure; Max Verstappen collides with Liam Lawson; watch every Mexico City GP session live on Sky Sports F1, with qualifying at 9pm on Saturday and the race at 8pm on Sunday
Highlights from Friday's practice sessions at the Mexico City Grand Prix
Charles Leclerc completed a Friday practice double at the Mexico City Grand Prix but Ferrari's strong showing was dampened by Lewis Hamilton suffering a technical issue.

Leclerc produced a time of 1:17.827s to finish just over a tenth clear of McLaren's Lando Norris and Mercedes' George Russell, with the British pair among 10 drivers who had earlier sat out the opening session to make way for rookie drivers.
Kimi Antonelli, who only needs to finish ninth in Sunday's race to become Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion, was a tenth down on his team-mate Russell in fourth.

Hamilton had been on course to go fastest as the session approached its midway point before suffering what appeared to be an engine issue in the final sector of his push lap.
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton complained about a power issue before retiring from FP2 at the Mexico City GP

He completed the lap but was then swiftly told by his engineer to pull over on track, ending his session early and denying him valuable information that his rivals were able to gather with their race simulations.
Max Verstappen, another to have sat out first practice, was three tenths off the pace in fifth, with his team-mate Isack Hadjar slotting in behind him.
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and Red Bull's Max Verstappen make contact during FP2 at the Mexico City GP
Verstappen was involved in a bizarre collision with his former team-mate Liam Lawson in the early stages of the session as the four-time world champion attempted to overtake the Racing Bulls driver.

Lawson defended and retained track position, only for the battle to continue on for several more corners before the pair made contact, leaving debris on the track that caused a red flag to be thrown so it could be cleared.
The pair will not only have to explain themselves to their teams, who are both part of the Red Bull family, but also the stewards as they were called to see them following the session.
